title: Prosecutors say AI influenced a teen accused of killing mother, brother
excerpt: Massachusetts prosecutors allege that a 17-year-old used ChatGPT to create scenarios about family violence that he acted on.
content_html:
Officials in Acton, Massachusetts, say a teenager charged with killing two members of his family was using generative AI chatbot ChatGPT to explore violent scenarios prior to the murders.

Arjun Aravind, 17, is accused of killing his 45-year-old mother, Sudha Venkatesan, and 14-year-old brother, Siddharth Aravind, this week. The boy's father was not home when the murders took place.

Arjun Aravind was located by police in nearby Wayland, Massachusetts, on Wednesday morning and taken into custody without incident. 

You May Also Like

Speaking to reporters following Aravind’s arrest, Middlesex County DA Marian Ryan made a point of highlighting Arjun Aravind's internet use, saying the teen created violent scenarios on ChatGPT and masked it as fantasy fiction.

"The investigation has so far shown that Arjun had recently been demonstrating some concerning behavior, including using the internet and ChatGPT to make searches for theoretical ideas or fantasy stories regarding the killing of his family," Ryan said, according to an NBC News report.

Mashable Light Speed

"He was engaged in the use of ChatGPT in creating fantasy stories, kind of the gothic novel kind of stories, asking questions, creating characters, asking what about this if this happened to that, and they seem to appear to relate to threats to his family."

Mashable's request for comment from OpenAI, the San Francisco company behind ChatGPT, was not returned as of press time.

While numerous parents have accused chatbots of playing a role in young people harming themselves, some prosecutors are now pointing the finger at AI companies for allegedly abetting crimes. Earlier this year, Florida man Hisham Abugharbieh was accused of killing two college students and using ChatGPT to inquire about disposing of the bodies.

OpenAI announced an update in December that purportedly puts "teen safety first" for underage users of ChatGPT. The company stated that it had refined its Model Spec, which guides how OpenAI's AI models should behave, and put a new set of principles in place for how it chatbot responds in high-stakes situations involving users under 18.

A report released in March from the Center for Countering Digital Hate found that eight out of 10 popular AI chatbots helped researchers posing as teen boys plan violent crimes in over half of the responses. 

Disclosure: Ziff Davis, Mashable’s parent company, in April 2025 filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging it infringed Ziff Davis copyrights in training and operating its AI systems.

content_html_zh:
马萨诸塞州阿克顿的官员表示，一名被控杀害两名家庭成员的青少年在谋杀前使用生成式人工智能聊天机器人 ChatGPT 来探索暴力场景。

17 岁的阿琼·阿拉文德 (Arjun Aravind) 被指控本周杀害了他 45 岁的母亲苏达·文卡特桑 (Sudha Venkatesan) 和 14 岁的兄弟悉达多·阿拉文德 (Siddharth Aravind)。 谋杀案发生时，男孩的父亲不在家。

周三上午，警方在马萨诸塞州韦兰附近找到了阿琼·阿拉文德 (Arjun Aravind)，并将其拘留，没有发生任何事件。

你可能也喜欢

阿拉文德被捕后，米德尔塞克斯县地方检察官玛丽安·瑞安 (Marian Ryan) 在接受记者采访时特别强调了阿琼·阿拉文德 (Arjun Aravind) 的互联网使用情况，称这名青少年在 ChatGPT 上创造了暴力场景，并将其伪装成奇幻小说。

据 NBC 新闻报道，瑞安表示：“迄今为止的调查显示，阿琼最近表现出了一些令人担忧的行为，包括利用互联网和 ChatGPT 搜索有关杀害其家人的理论想法或幻想故事。”

可混搭光速

“他使用 ChatGPT 来创作奇幻故事，一种哥特式小说的故事，提出问题，创造角色，询问如果这件事发生在那件事上怎么办，这些似乎与对他家人的威胁有关。”

截至发稿时，Mashable 向 ChatGPT 背后的旧金山公司 OpenAI 提出置评请求，但尚未得到回复。

尽管许多家长指责聊天机器人在年轻人伤害自己的过程中发挥了作用，但一些检察官现在将矛头指向人工智能公司涉嫌教唆犯罪。 今年早些时候，佛罗里达州男子希沙姆·阿布哈比 (Hisham Abugharbieh) 被指控杀害了两名大学生，并使用 ChatGPT 询问尸体处理事宜。

OpenAI 在 12 月宣布了一项更新，据称将 ChatGPT 未成年用户的“青少年安全放在第一位”。 该公司表示，它已经完善了模型规范，该规范指导 OpenAI 的人工智能模型应如何表现，并为聊天机器人在涉及 18 岁以下用户的高风险情况下如何响应制定了一套新原则。

反数字仇恨中心三月份发布的一份报告发现，在超过一半的回复中，十分之八的流行人工智能聊天机器人帮助研究人员假扮成十几岁的男孩计划暴力犯罪。

披露：Mashable 的母公司 Ziff Davis 于 2025 年 4 月对 OpenAI 提起诉讼，指控其在训练和运营其人工智能系统时侵犯了 Ziff Davis 的版​​权。
